Name: Nude Scarecrow and Devices (Cont.)
Author: xrogaan
Description:
Bring the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/628]Scarecrow and devices[/url] to 1.6 by properly using ContentPatcher feature. You'll probably want Generic Config Menu to configure which version to display. The mod defaults to clean scarecrow only.

I also took the liberty to fix the non-BDSM version, which were displaying BDSM flavored scarecrows.

Alternatively, you can opt to use the Alternative Textures conversion made by KingTrillis313.

[size=4][b][u]Configure the Scarecrow flavor[/u][/b][/size]

If you do not have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url] installed, create a config.json with the following content:

[code]{
  "ModFlavor": "S-Clean"
}
[/code]
Scarecrow has 5 flavors. D is for device, S is for scarecrow. Chose the one that matches your fancy. The module defaults to S-Clean.
[list]
[*]D+S-BDSM
[*]D+S-Clean
[*]D+S-Cum
[*]S-Cum
[*]S-Clean
[*]S-BDSM
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]Permissions[/u][/b][/size]

I have set restrictive permissions as I am not not original author of the pixel art. I have received Yukovalis permission to publish an update, but I am not aware of any prior agreement. I assume it would be permissive, but I cannot set permissions any differently until stated explicitly otherwise.

[size=4][b][u]Credits[/u][/b][/size]

Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/628]YukoValis' work[/url].
Alternative Textures version by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194248826-kingtrillis313/]KingTrillis313[/url]

[size=4][b][u]Tools used[/u][/b][/size]

I made use of the following tools:
[list]
[*][url=https://imagemagick.org/]ImageMagick[/url]﻿: To crop the Craftable.png tile and generate individual sprites.
[*][url=https://www.python.org/]Python[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/]gawk[/url]﻿: To generate the content.json file based on the sprites metadata
[*][url=https://www.aseprite.org/]Aseprite[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://loadingartist.com/comic/full-bodied-coffee/]Coffee[/url]﻿
[/list]
